notablePrerequisites: Marwyn does not have summoning sickness and has a power of five or greater.
description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, targeting Marwyn.
Malachite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Marwyn.
Repeat.
If Marwyn has power six or greater, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may then target any other permanent using Malachite Talisman's ability.
